newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian economy minister sees growth sustained.
newsitem.headline: Croatian economy minister sees growth sustained.

text.p: Croatian Economy Minister Nenad Porges said on Monday he expected the country's real growth rate to be between 5.5 and 7.0 percent after 6.0 percent last year.
"Growth in 1996 was six percent or more and I expect sustainable growth to be between 5.5 and 7.0 percent over the next few years," Porges told Reuters in an interview.
